name: What paint sheen is best for bathroom walls and ceilings?

mainEntity.name: What paint sheen is best for bathroom walls and ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint sheen for a bathroom is satin or semi-gloss because bathrooms endure high humidity and frequent cleaning. A semi-gloss finish repels water droplets effectively and resists mildew buildup, making it ideal for walls right next to showers or around vanities. Satin provides a slightly softer look with good moisture resistance for well-ventilated half-baths or powder rooms. Flat and matte sheens should generally be avoided on bathroom walls because they absorb moisture, stain easily, and can break down when wiped clean. HH Remodeling prepares surfaces thoroughly to ensure the selected finish adheres smoothly over repaired drywall or existing coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-gloss or satin paint is best for bathrooms because both sheens resist moisture, wipe clean easily, and prevent water absorption on walls and ceilings.
